name: pinchbench
title_zh: 用真实任务给 OpenClaw 智能体跑分排名
tagline_zh: 日历、邮件、研究、编程、多步流程——五类真实任务一测便知。跑完直接提交榜单，跟别人家智能体硬碰硬比高低。
tagline_en: Calendar, email, research, coding, multi-step flows—five real-world task types. Run, submit to the leaderboard.
desc_en: Run PinchBench benchmarks to evaluate OpenClaw agent performance across real-world tasks. Use when testing model capabilities, comparing models, submitting benchmark results to the leaderboard, or checking how well your OpenClaw setup handles calendar, email, research, coding, and multi-step workflows.
why_zh: 不是自说自话的玩具题，是带评分基准的标准化测试。同一把尺子量所有智能体，结果可复现、可对比、可上榜。
why_en: Not toy prompts—standardized, scored benchmarks. One ruler for every agent, reproducible results you can compare and rank.
limit_zh: 只测 OpenClaw 智能体，且只覆盖日历、邮件、研究、编码、多步流程这五类任务。不测视觉、语音、多模态。
limit_en: OpenClaw agents only; covers just calendar, email, research, coding, multi-step flows. No vision/speech/multimodal. Needs OpenClaw installed.
